cutInfo.title: How the deck is rebuilt
cutInfo.intro: The deck is never shuffled during a match, only once before the first deal.
cutInfo.collect: Between deals it is rebuilt from the tricks just played: the dealer team's won tricks go on top of the other team's. Within each pile, tricks stay in the order they were won, and each trick keeps its cards in the order they were played.
cutInfo.cutOnly: The cut is the only thing that reorders the deck between deals, so where you pinch really matters.
cutInfo.nudge: To keep cuts imprecise, the server nudges every cut by up to one card either way.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.desc.ampindramo_adalana: Announce a Colour mode without any trump cards in hand, and still win the deal.
achievements.desc.papango_no_namana: Capture 3 opponent Nines in a single AllTrumps deal.

achievements.desc.kamokamo_mitsoaka_raha: Save a singleton 9 (AllTrumps) or singleton 10 by being void in the led suit.
achievements.desc.fotsy_marik_ilay_fahad: Win a match while your opponents have 0 match points.
achievements.desc.mpitondra_dilizansy_en: Win a deal and personally win 6+ tricks playing cards of the same suit.
achievements.desc.mena_taratry_ny_afo_ts: Sweep all 8 tricks in a Colour mode while doubled or redoubled.
achievements.desc.azafady_kely_tompoko: Sweep all 8 tricks in NoTrumps while doubled or redoubled.
achievements.desc.manafosafo_sy_mividy_t: Announce NoTrumps, opponent escalates to AllTrumps, your team doubles and wins the last deal.
achievements.desc.mpitsapa_lanitra_aminy: Capture 3 opponent Tens in a single NoTrumps deal.
achievements.desc.mpamadika_basy_marovav: Win a match after being down 0-124 or worse in match points.
achievements.desc.kambana_vavy_sy_lahy: End a deal with both teams having exactly the same card points.

achievements.desc.mbola_tsy_bedy: Win an AllTrumps deal without either teammate holding any Jack.

achievements.desc.sweep_in_colour: Sweep all 8 tricks in a Colour game mode.

achievements.desc.tanalahy_ny_foko: Announce a Colour, see the deal end in AllTrumps or NoTrumps, and personally win 5+ tricks with cards of one same suit different from the one you announced.
achievements.desc.tsy_mba_nanisa_fa_nian: Deny the opponents' sweep by personally winning the very last trick, your team's only trick of the deal.
